name: Aevis Victoria SA
summary: Aevis Victoria SA engages in the healthcare, hospitality, lifestyle, and infrastructure sectors in Switzerland. It operates through Hospitals, Hospitality, and Real Estate segments. The company operates private hospitals, hotels, radiology institutes, pharmacy, urology center, health center, day clinics, spas, patient hotels, and golf courses. It also provides health management programs, lifestyle coaching and anti-aging cosmeceuticals under the Nescens brand. In addition, the company offers ambulance, life sciences related services, medical home, physiotherapy, ophthalmology, sports medicine, medical radiation, stem cells, cosmetics, parking, cleaning services, sterilization, and IT related…
